_readme: This file is EMPTY on purpose. It grants permits, so it is populated by a
human review, never by a script and never by an agent.
Measured 2026-07-25 on this repo: 784 findings in the six blocking classes,
across 450 files. Each one needs its own written justification saying why
that specific line is a known, accepted, non-leaking record. Nothing in the
delta design proves those 784 are false positives, so a bulk accept would
pre-authorize any fact that leaked before this gate shipped.
single reason for the set, an empty reason, and a reason for a fact that is
not present. load_baseline_document() re-runs those checks so a hand-edit
of this file is caught too.
classifier_sha256 is stamped when the baseline is first populated; the
preflight refuses a baseline built by a different classifier.
